verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev exposes concurrency limits (to cap simultaneous executions) and a run lifecycle that includes a 'Delayed' state, which touches the 'delay' part of the story, but there is no documented debounce or batch primitive for collapsing noisy event streams into a single run. missing for 10: explicit debounce API, explicit event-batching API, and any first-party or community example of collapsing repeated triggers into one run.
